mona (Sales): Quick sync — Specter Systems wants a 2-week POC. They have a custom variant 'orca-lite-12b-q4' exported from their trainer. Questions: reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo, KV cache behavior (session persistent), Dedicated on A100, and Private VPC with BYO-KMS. cc @alejandro_ml @sam_ops @liya_sec

alejandro_ml (Eng-ML): Clarify: does their export include fused ops or custom kernels? If so we'll need the unfused checkpoint or the fused op sources. Also what's their latency SLO and typical lengths?

mona (Sales): They want p95 < 300ms. Prompts ~25 tokens, responses ~180 tokens avg. They mentioned some operator fusion during export.

alejandro_ml (Eng-ML): Fusion could cause kernel mismatches. For staging I recommend int8/q4 quant path and prefix_session KV cache. Example smoke config: ```
model: orca-lite-12b-q4
precision: q4
hardware: a100-80gb
batching:
  latency_target_ms: 250
kv_cache: prefix_session
sequence_max: 2048
```

alejandro_ml (Eng-ML): If we can't get an unfused checkpoint, expect a compatibility test and possibly a custom runtime build (adds ~3 business days). Also need a small validation set (30-50 prompts) and a concurrency profile (peak conc).

sam_ops (Solutions): Ballpark reserved effective rate for similar 12B quant variants on A100 is $0.005–0.012 per 1k tokens depending on cache hit and utilization. I'll refine after perf numbers.

liya_sec (Security): BYO-KMS + Private VPC supported. We'll need their KMS ARN, key policy, retention/rotation requirements, and completed security questionnaire. If no PHI it's standard flow.

mona (Sales): I'll request unfused checkpoint, 40 prompts, and concurrency shape. They've confirmed no PHI.

ticket-bot: Ticket POC-4321 created: "specter-poc-staging" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. ETA: 48h.

alejandro_ml (Eng-ML): Once I have artifacts I'll run perf + quality check on staging and report kernel/op fallbacks. If fused ops are present please also share the training repo commit and CUDA build info.

sam_ops (Solutions): After eng-ml results I'll draft reserved pool recommendation and an initial quote within 48h.

mona (Sales): Thanks. I'll push the ask and update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:
